name: Plateau State Coordinating Unit — Inauguration & Induction
summary: Inauguration of the Plateau State Coordinating Unit in Jos on 5 August 2026, followed by induction of local government and ward coordinators across the state's 17 LGAs.

name: Benue State Executive Committee — Inauguration
summary: Inauguration of the Benue State Executive Committee in Makurdi, with a charge to build a structure reaching communities, markets and religious institutions across all 23 local government areas.

name: National Ward Mobiliser Induction Programme
summary: Rolling induction of ward-level mobilisers, running out of the National Secretariat in Abuja and cascading through zonal and state coordinating units to every registration area in the federation.

name: Civic Education Caravan — North West
summary: A travelling civic-education and voter-awareness programme across the seven North West states, run in markets, motor parks and campuses in partnership with state coordinating units.

name: Lagos Youth Town Hall Series
summary: Quarterly town halls connecting young Lagosians to their elected representatives at state and federal level, with published summaries of commitments made.

name: National Peace Pledge Campaign
summary: A nationwide pledge campaign against political violence, hate speech, intimidation and misinformation, anchored by religious and traditional institutions in each participating state.

name: Fact-Check Fellows — Misinformation Response
summary: Training young volunteers in each local government to identify and counter political misinformation circulating in their communities, with a rapid-response network coordinated from Abuja.

name: Borno Youth Cohesion Dialogues
summary: Structured dialogue sessions bringing together young people across communities in Maiduguri and Jere, focused on de-escalation and shared civic participation.

name: State Digital Skills Clusters
summary: Training clusters hosted by state coordinating units, covering foundational and intermediate digital skills and signposting participants to federal technology and financing programmes.

name: Young Content Creators Showcase
summary: A national showcase for young Nigerian content creators and digital storytellers, with regional heats hosted by state coordinating units.

name: Student Loan Scheme Application Clinics
summary: Campus clinics helping students understand and complete applications to the federal student loan scheme, run with institutional student affairs offices.

name: Out-of-School Youth Re-entry Outreach
summary: Identifying out-of-school young people at ward level and linking them to vocational, literacy and formal re-entry pathways available in the state.

name: Young Farmers' Clusters
summary: Local government level clusters connecting young farmers to inputs, extension advice and buyers, with a focus on treating farming as an enterprise rather than a fallback.

name: Agribusiness Market Linkage Programme
summary: Connecting young producers in Kwara to aggregators and processors, and profiling those who have built viable agribusinesses for peer learning.

name: Enterprise & Access-to-Finance Clinics
summary: Clinics helping young business owners register formally, understand credit schemes, and prepare the documentation lenders and federal programmes require.

name: Employer Linkage Fairs
summary: State-level fairs convening employers, training providers and young jobseekers, with follow-up placement tracking by the state coordinating unit.

name: Young Women's Leadership Track
summary: A dedicated leadership pipeline ensuring young women hold coordinating positions at ward, local government and state level, not only supporting roles.

name: Accessible Participation Standard
summary: A programme-wide accessibility standard for venues, materials and communications, so young persons with disabilities can take part in every RHYE activity.
